senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga, nama diri atau nama tempat.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Winslow；输入未说明具体人物或地点。所列 IPA 为英语读音，不代表已确立的马来语规范读音。马来语释义为编写释义，搭配及例句为教学拟写，频率未核实。[姓名与读音资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/winslow), [英国地方政府地名资料](https://media.buckinghamshire.gov.uk/documents/Winslow-complete-adopted-doc.qxd_.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The English surname Winslow is associated with the town of Winslow in Buckinghamshire. A local-government conservation account explains the place name as probably Anglo-Saxon, referring to Wini's burial mound. The name subsequently also appears as a personal name. This history concerns English naming traditions and does not supply a Malay lexical meaning. [Buckinghamshire conservation account](https://media.buckinghamshire.gov.uk/documents/Winslow-complete-adopted-doc.qxd_.pdf), [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/winslow?geo-lang=en-US)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到近似“温兹洛”，先联想到人名或地名；把 Winslow 当完整专名记忆。
